answer: Weight each seat's votes and grading pay by coin-days: POA held unmoved times epochs held, reset to zero whenever those coins move. A fresh key starts weightless, and since any transfer, even between your own keys, destroys the age, one aged relic balance can back only one seat at a time. Giving 50 aliases 1,000 coin-days each needs 50,000 locked coin-days, linear in N, so pushing a tide of new keys to the summit of a ballot costs real idle capital. Renting fails too: borrowed coins arrive at age zero.
